description: Security, Quality and Observability - Transversal requirements covering workspace boundary enforcement, Markdown sanitization, secret management, test suites, structured logging, optional LangSmith tracing, and pipeline resilience.

userStories.title: Enforce workspace boundary in API filesystem routes
userStories.description: As a developer, I need all file system operations in the API to be restricted to the configured workspace directory so that path traversal attacks are prevented.
acceptanceCriteria: Create a resolveWorkspacePath util in apps/api/src
Throw a 403 when resolved path escapes the workspace root
All routes in files.ts and workspace.ts use this util
Requests with path traversal return 403 and never touch the filesystem
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Created apps/api/src/utils/workspace-boundary.ts exporting resolveWorkspacePath and WorkspaceBoundaryError (statusCode 403). All inline path-traversal checks in files.ts and workspace.ts replaced with this utility. Typecheck passes.

userStories.title: Sanitize Markdown preview rendering in frontend
userStories.description: As a user, I want the Markdown preview to be safe so that malicious HTML or scripts embedded in notes cannot execute in my browser.
acceptanceCriteria: Install dompurify and @types/dompurify in apps/web
MarkdownPreview passes rendered HTML through DOMPurify.sanitize()
A note with script tags renders as escaped text
A note with onerror payload has the handler stripped
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: dompurify ^3.2.3 and @types/dompurify ^3.0.5 in apps/web/package.json. MarkdownPreview.tsx imports DOMPurify and applies sanitizeContent() with FORBID_TAGS and FORBID_ATTR before passing to react-markdown, which also runs rehype-sanitize. Typecheck passes.

userStories.title: Separate secret config from app config and mask secrets in logs
userStories.description: As a developer, I need API keys and secrets to be isolated in environment variables and never exposed in log output.
acceptanceCriteria: Create apps/api/src/config.ts with zod validation
App startup fails fast with clear error if required vars are missing
Add .env.example at repo root
Root .gitignore ignores .env files
Secrets filtered/masked in logs
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: apps/api/src/config.ts created with zod envSchema. Startup fails fast on missing WORKSPACE_ROOT. Fastify logger in app.ts has redact config for authorization, x-api-key, apiKey, key, token, password, secret fields. Typecheck passes.

userStories.title: Configure ESLint across monorepo and add lint gate
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a single ESLint config enforced across all packages.
acceptanceCriteria: eslint.config.js at monorepo root with TypeScript rules
Each package.json in apps/* and packages/* has a lint script
Root package.json has turbo run lint script
turbo.json includes lint pipeline task
pnpm lint exits 0 on clean codebase
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: eslint.config.js present at root using typescript-eslint flat config. Root package.json has lint: turbo run lint script. turbo.json has lint task. All apps and packages have lint scripts. Typecheck passes.

userStories.title: Add unit tests for ai-core and ai-pipelines packages
userStories.description: As a developer, I want unit tests for the AI packages so domain logic is verified independently.
acceptanceCriteria: Install vitest in packages/ai-core and packages/ai-pipelines
Each package has a test script
At least one test per pipeline using mock LLM
Tests verify expected structure
All tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: vitest ^1.6.0 added to both packages. Test files created: mock-provider.test.ts, summarize.test.ts, rewrite.test.ts, create-prd.test.ts. Each tests happy-path (completed event with non-empty output) and empty-content failure. Typecheck passes.

userStories.title: Add integration tests for API health and workspace routes
userStories.description: As a developer, I want integration tests for health and workspace routes.
acceptanceCriteria: Install supertest and vitest in apps/api
apps/api has a test script
GET /health test asserts 200 and { status: ok }
GET /api/workspace/tree test asserts 200 and array
Tests use temp directories
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: vitest, supertest, @types/supertest added to apps/api devDeps. Created apps/api/src/__tests__/routes.test.ts testing GET /health and GET /api/workspace/tree with temp WORKSPACE_ROOT. Typecheck passes.

userStories.title: Add integration tests for API files and runs routes
userStories.description: As a developer, I want integration tests for the files and runs routes.
acceptanceCriteria: PUT /api/files/content creates a file and test asserts it exists
GET /api/files/content returns the file content written in previous step
GET /api/runs/:id returns 404 for unknown runId
Each test uses temp directory and cleans up
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Created apps/api/src/__tests__/files.test.ts: tests PUT /api/files/content (creates file, asserts file on disk, returns 200 with savedAt), GET /api/files/content (returns written content), GET for missing file (404), GET /api/runs/:non-existent (404 'Run not found'). Uses mkdtempSync temp dir, cleaned in afterAll. Typecheck passes.

userStories.title: Add smoke tests for CLI pipeline commands
userStories.description: As a developer, I want smoke tests that invoke each CLI command against a fixture file.
acceptanceCriteria: Add test:smoke script in CLI package
Smoke test for summarize command with mocked provider, asserts output and exit 0
Smoke test for rewrite command, same pattern
Smoke test for create-prd command, same pattern
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Added vitest ^1.6.0 to apps/cli devDeps. Added test:smoke and test scripts. Created fixture at apps/cli/src/__tests__/fixtures/sample.md. Created smoke.test.ts: mocks ../lib/api.js (apiFetch returns 202 with runId, consumeSSE simulates token_stream+completed), spies on process.stdout.write and process.exit, runs each command via Commander.parseAsync, asserts stdout contains mock output and exitCode 0. Typecheck passes.

userStories.title: Add structured logging with runId correlation to API
userStories.description: As a developer, I want every API request to emit structured JSON logs tagged with a runId.
acceptanceCriteria: Install pino in apps/api
Replace console.log/error calls with pino logger
Each request gets a runId injected into log context
Log lines include runId, method, path, statusCode, durationMs
Log level configurable via LOG_LEVEL env
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: pino ^9.6.0 and pino-pretty already in apps/api. Fastify logger with level from LOG_LEVEL (default info). Added onRequest hook in app.ts: request.log = request.log.child({ runId: request.id }). Added onResponse hook logging { method, path, statusCode, durationMs }. No console.* calls in apps/api/src. Typecheck passes.

userStories.title: Add optional LangSmith tracing to ai-pipelines
userStories.description: As a developer, I want pipeline executions to be optionally traced in LangSmith.
acceptanceCriteria: LangSmith tracing enabled only when LANGSMITH_API_KEY and LANGCHAIN_TRACING_V2=true are set
When vars absent, pipelines run normally with no side-effects
Each pipeline wraps its execution with a LangSmith-compatible run name and tags
Add LANGSMITH_API_KEY, LANGCHAIN_PROJECT, LANGCHAIN_TRACING_V2 to .env.example
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Created packages/ai-pipelines/src/tracing.ts exporting isTracingEnabled(), startTrace(pipelineName, runId), endTrace(ctx, output?, error?). Tracing is no-op when LANGSMITH_API_KEY or LANGCHAIN_TRACING_V2=true are absent. All 3 pipelines call startTrace() and endTrace(). Variables already in .env.example. Typecheck passes.

userStories.title: Capture and log pipeline execution metadata
userStories.description: As a developer, I want each pipeline run to log its latency and errors.
acceptanceCriteria: Each pipeline records startedAt and finishedAt timestamps
durationMs logged at info level
Pipeline errors logged at error level with runId, pipeline name, error message
No sensitive content in logs
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Added @evennotes/observability dependency to packages/ai-pipelines. Each pipeline records startedAt and computes durationMs. Uses createLogger() from @evennotes/observability: logs info 'pipeline completed' with { runId, pipeline, durationMs, outputLength } and error 'pipeline failed' with { runId, pipeline, durationMs, error }. console.warn calls replaced with logger.warn. No raw API keys or full prompts in logs. Typecheck passes.

userStories.title: Add configurable timeouts and retry logic to pipeline execution
userStories.description: As a developer, I want pipeline calls to respect a timeout and retry conservatively on transient errors.
acceptanceCriteria: Pipeline respects PIPELINE_TIMEOUT_MS env var (default 30000ms)
Transient errors (HTTP 429, 503) retried up to 2 times with exponential backoff
Non-retriable errors (400, 401) fail immediately
All error paths surface human-readable message
Add PIPELINE_TIMEOUT_MS and PIPELINE_MAX_RETRIES to .env.example
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Created packages/ai-pipelines/src/resilience.ts with getPipelineTimeout(), getMaxRetries(), withTimeout<T>(), isRetriable(), withRetry<T>() (exponential backoff 500ms*2^attempt). Each pipeline wraps model invocation in withTimeout+withRetry. Non-retriable errors throw immediately. All catch blocks emit PipelineEvent {type:'failed', error: message} without raw stacks. PIPELINE_TIMEOUT_MS and PIPELINE_MAX_RETRIES already in .env.example. Typecheck passes.
